name: queen-and-spadina-legend
js: (() => { const app = window.__CITY_APP; app.teleportTo(-1096, -729, 0); app.cameraSystem.cinema = () => ({ pos: [-1096, 500, -729], look: [-1096, 0, -727], fov: 45 }); setTimeout(() => { const p = window.CITY.BUILDING_PRESETS; console.log("[presets-debug] " + (p ? ("attached " + p.attached + " of " + p.ids.length + " presets, error " + p.error) : "no presets loaded")); console.log("[requests] " + performance.getEntriesByType("resource").map((e) => e.name.replace(location.origin, "").split("?")[0]).filter((v, i, a) => a.indexOf(v) === i).sort().join(" ")); }, 3500); })()
